title: Lodhi Dynasty Behlul Lodhi
definition: The Lodhi Dynasty (1451–1526) was the final ruling house of the Delhi Sultanate, representing the first Afghan dynasty in India, founded by Behlul Lodhi after the decline of the Sayyid Dynasty.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for understanding the transition from Turkic-Persian to Afghan political culture, the shift in the nature of kingship (from 'Sultan' to 'First among equals'), and the geopolitical precursors to the Mughal conquest.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Lodhi Dynasty Behlul Lodhi.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
